units.label: Estimator: fractional logit

anchors.quote: Main model: fractional logit (Papke & Wooldridge 1996), i.e. a binomial
This is a binomial quasi-likelihood GLM with a logit link, fit to each district's share.

units.basis: CLAUDE.md (rule 9)

anchors.quote: keep = cooks <= 4 / n

units.basis: methods-kit:robustness, which A-HL1 asked for (rule 9); computing Cook's distance with the estimated dispersion was Claude's call inside it. The T3 reply describes the check and the dispersion fix; the author's only response is a bare /attest (P10)

units.label: Robustness: OLS on the log-odds of the share (the skill's)

anchors.quote: logodds = np.log(y / (1 - y))
**Functional form.** OLS (HC1) with the log-odds of the share, log(p / (1 − p)), as the outcome.
